adjudication.rationale: In EventManager.ts, after refactoring `calendarReference` to an array and updating all calendar references in a loop, the merge/reschedule cleanup path still uses `booking.references.find((reference) => reference.type.includes("_calendar"))` to select the old calendar event to delete. This will only delete the first matching calendar reference and can leave other `_calendar` references (e.g., additional hosts’/destinations’ events created by the new multi-destination-calendar logic) orphaned after a merge/reschedule.
